study: Native /api/chat geometry rendering and thinking control

counting_rules.correct: Valid final A/B content agrees with the frozen geometric label.
counting_rules.valid_wrong_choices: A valid final A/B answer disagrees with the label; excludes missing answers.
counting_rules.budget_truncated: Native done_reason=length, whether or not a final choice exists. Not counted as a reasoning error.
counting_rules.invalid_final_format_total: No valid final A/B answer, including budget truncation. See nonbudget_format_failures separately.
counting_rules.pairing: Two option orders repeat one structure-level decision; eight prompts per group are four source structures, not eight independent chemistry samples.
counting_rules.semantic_swap_consistent: Both final choices observed and the selected semantic alternative remains unchanged after A/B reversal; null if an answer is missing.

observations: thinking=false: original_xyz has four valid correct choices and four valid wrong choices; all eight answers are A, so none of the four source pairs preserves its semantic answer after swapping options.
thinking=false: tool_distances has eight valid correct choices and four both-correct source pairs.

thinking=true: original_xyz has seven valid final answers, all correct, plus one budget-censored run with done_reason=length, eval_count=1024 and empty final content; there are three both-correct pairs and one censored pair.
thinking=true: tool_distances has eight valid correct choices and four both-correct source pairs.

budget_and_latency_interpretation.compute_matching: Both modes have the same maximum output-token budget. Actual eval_count differs sharply; this is not a consumed-compute-matched comparison.
budget_and_latency_interpretation.token_measure: eval_count is the native server-reported generated-token count, including the thinking-mode generation before its final answer. It is not inferred from the length of the A/B final content.
budget_and_latency_interpretation.timing_measure: All durations are saved native server fields, converted from nanoseconds to seconds. No client/host walltime was saved in these records.
budget_and_latency_interpretation.warm_cold: All 32 saved load_duration values are very small (range 0.000480917 to 0.002582250 seconds), consistent with an already resident model. No explicit cold-start/reload trial or warm/cold assignment was recorded, so no cold-versus-warm effect is estimable.
budget_and_latency_interpretation.limits: Server total/prompt/eval durations describe this deployment and execution order. Hardware, caching, prompt length, model loading and scheduling can affect elapsed time. Neither server elapsed time nor unrecorded host walltime establishes intrinsic algorithmic cost.
budget_and_latency_interpretation.truncation: The one empty final answer is budget censored, not a demonstrated wrong geometric choice. A separate exact-request follow-up may change only num_predict to 2048 and must not overwrite this observation.
budget_and_latency_interpretation.thinking_flag_confound: The think flag changes native template/conditioning and actual generated computation together. These observations cannot attribute improvement solely to more computation or isolate a pure reasoning-step effect. The same maximum 1024-token budget is not the same consumed budget.

scope.population: Four previously frozen structures from the same NB1 reaction, using the local Qwen deployment in this manifest.
scope.distance_condition: The tool_distances condition supplies precomputed distances and outsources the Euclidean calculation; it is not purely a coordinate re-rendering.
scope.thinking_comparison: Exploratory within-deployment observation: think changes native rendering/conditioning and consumed generation together, under equal maximum output budgets. It neither isolates a pure reasoning-step effect nor attributes improvement solely to additional computation.
not_established: General molecular-geometry competence or independent chemistry-task accuracy.
Scientific validity, mechanism correctness, full research success or quantum-chemical evidence acceptance.
The internal cause of the historical DeepSeek behavior or a repair of those original trajectories.
